controls.source: GOB 260 stores a 4.0 s Blind state (90) on landing with 100% chance and no control immunity; Blind applies CombatTactics -30 via its linked record and does not lock combat actions.
controls.runtime: TimedEffects.ApplyToPlayer sends the Blind state record (kind 0x11, 260 -> 90, 4.0 s) and its linked record (kind 0x1d, 90 -> 163, -30), keeps ControlActions.CanUseAbilities/CanPerformSpecialMove open while AbilityStats applies -30 accuracy, and emits matched removals plus StateEnd (0x7a000034) on expiry.
controls.test: PR580 native pr580b PacketLog 3594/3875/3968/4139-4140 captures stock 260 landing on player QAEnemy, Blind 4.0 s + linked -30 add, Cheap Shot (198) admitted while blinded (20 s own timer start), and matched removals plus StateEnd at 3.95 s. MartialBlindEnrageAreaMode and MartialBlindEnrageAreaTests cover the full live flow. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/580

controls.source: GOB 266 stores an 8.0 s Enraged state (93) at 20% ProcTriggerChance with no control immunity; EnrageInit locks interlock withdrawal until expiry.

targeting.source: GOB 268 stores CastWhenUsed 2, CastValidTarget 0, selector 4, and a 3.0 m caster-centred hostile area with Karate 132 required.
targeting.runtime: CasterHostileArea resolves hostile NPCs and PvP-eligible players within 3.0 m of the caster at cast completion, excluding friendly and out-of-radius targets.
